items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: And then Harold, myself, a piano player by the name of Bob King.

ctx.x: The Twins of Dixieland was called?

Harold and Howard Cooper, yes. In fact, I have the rights to that album. It really turned out to be a pretty good album. There was a couple of good players on it. One of which, the drummer had been the drummer for Louis Armstrong's big band. A guy by the name of James Harris, known as Coatesville Harris. And the two Cooper boys played, well, no, I'm sorry. Howard had died and Charlie Borneman was a trombone player. And then Harold, myself, a piano player by the name of Bob King. And a bass player named Junior…
So we had a good enough man and somehow they managed to get through it.
